verdict.rationale: Replit documents an official Replit MCP Server that external compatible clients can connect to in order to create, inspect, or update Replit Apps (replit-docs-42), which is exactly the story of connecting an agent via an official MCP server (distinct from Replit Agent acting as an MCP client to third-party services, e.g. replit-docs-12/20/41). This is first-party documented capability with a dedicated docs page (connect-through-mcp.md). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of connecting an external agent to Replit's MCP server, and more detail on auth/setup flow or limitations.
